problem:
An inner product on $V={R}^{3}$ is given by $⟨x,y⟩=2{x}_{1}{y}_{1}+5{x}_{2}{y}_{2}+7{x}_{3}{y}_{3}.$ Find $⟨x,y⟩$, if

$$
x=[\begin{aligned}2 \\ 1 \\ -2\end{aligned}],\,y=[\begin{aligned}3 \\ -3 \\ -2\end{aligned}].
$$

feedback.problem:
An inner product on $V={R}^{3}$ is given by $⟨x,y⟩=2{x}_{1}{y}_{1}+{x}_{2}{y}_{2}+9{x}_{3}{y}_{3}.$ Find $⟨x,y⟩$, if

$$
x=[\begin{aligned}1 \\ -2 \\ 1\end{aligned}],\,y=[\begin{aligned}5 \\ 3 \\ 1\end{aligned}].
$$
feedback.worked_solution:
Computing the inner product according to the definition, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}⟨x,y⟩ & =2{x}_{1}{y}_{1}+{x}_{2}{y}_{2}+9{x}_{3}{y}_{3} \\  & =2\cdot 1\cdot 5+(-2)\cdot 3+9\cdot 1\cdot 1 \\  & =10-6+9 \\  & =13.\end{aligned}
$$
